name: conduction_2d_square_plate
title: Two-dimensional steady conduction in a square plate
summary: Finite-difference solution of the 2-D steady conduction equation in a square plate: the temperature of every node of a (N+2)x(N+2) grid is the average of its four neighbours, with two edges at 100 C, one edge at 0 C and one insulated.

origin.notes: EES example of F-Chart Software, distributed by the EES-Community/ees-examples repository (commit 5c703d0, folder Case_Study/). EES ID stamp: EES licence #0001: For use only by Professor S.A. Klein University of Wisconsin - Madison klein. Credit: (c) F-Chart Software / S. A. Klein, MIT via EES-Community/ees-examples. The byte-identical copy 2-D Conduction (1).EES of the same folder is inventory row EEL-008.

verification.summary: Runnable variant vs the solution stored in the original EES file: 730 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001), largest relative deviation 1.6e-08. The discrete energy balance of the plate closes to 9e-12 and the boundary conditions are met exactly. The native file is blocked by CS-GAP-INDEX-VAR.
verification.reference: EES stored solution of ~/Nextcloud/thermo_models/EES_library/2-D Conduction.EES (730 decoded variables: the 729 node temperatures and N); discrete energy balance of the plate and boundary conditions checked by hand on the CoolSolve solution; grid-convergence check with N = 51
verification.notes: compare_solution.py (runnable variant vs the EES stored solution): 730 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 0; only in CoolSolve: 0. Largest relative deviation 1.63e-08 (T[23,26] and T[23,25], 13.71 C); the same order (1.6e-08) on every node, from the six significant digits of the EES display format. The system is linear and converges in 2 iterations; the .initials file (the EES values) is not needed. Grid refinement to N = 51 moves a node temperature by at most 0.04 K.

related_external: CoolSolve examples: none; the plain-text mirror of the source example is in the EES-Community/ees-examples repository (Case_Study/2-d_conduction.ees, commit 5c703d0)
